title.narrative: YES -Youth and women Empowerment & Support ¿ Together we can

description.narrative: The action addresses structural problems and social injustice of the society, with particular reference to women and youth. The project targets the women and youth civil society organizations (CSOs) and community based groups (CBOs) as the main drivers of change of the society and it is designed to strengthen their capacities, in rural and urban areas, by giving responses and support to women and youth to promote their awareness of their human rights, inclusion, participation and economic empowerment
